scope: Nine current published local Hunyuan MV architecture/cliff assets. History preserved; bounds-only references created no artistic mesh; root performed actual AI concept and final five-view reviews.
provenance_hash_policy: All nine published GLBs were read and SHA-256 checked against runtime manifest, publish stage and source export record; upstream file hashes are historical stage metadata. No inference, Blender or complete tests ran during this collection.

aperture.method: World-transform decoded GLB triangles to game XYZ, clip each triangle against all six opening-box planes over full actual depth. Count positive-area intersections. Raw source plus exact architectureMatrix uniform fit using the union of all LOD bounds, X/Z centering and foot grounding. No geometry edits or render.
